answer: Pair every newcomer with a stranger drawn by lot for a short live session at a shared mesa: together they must forge one useful artefact, each writing a complementary half in real time, while a falcon-eyed witness watches the transcript. Neither half works alone, so a single operator cannot sit in two sessions at once, and a copied pair's halves will not fit. The finished artefact is published, strangers check it, and only a pair whose halves mesh earns standing. Pairs rotate each season, so no fake can rehearse twice. Fraud freezes both identities until a new live session clears them.
